description: Data scientist and software engineer with 12 years of experience in computational research and open-source infrastructure for neuroscience. Curated 256 TB of datasets to NIH archives, built 12+ data pipelines for research labs, and currently maintain petabyte-scale cloud archives at Dartmouth. Trained researchers from dozens of universities through conference workshops and hackathons. Deep toolkit in Python, AWS, DevOps, and cloud-optimized data formats (HDF5, Zarr), with a Ph.D. foundation in time series analysis, nonlinear dynamics, and machine learning.
